verdict.rationale: Klaviyo has a dedicated webhooks docs page with an account-level webhooks resource ('Get all webhooks in an account'). This indicates a first-party webhooks capability, but the pack only shows a list operation and nothing on registering endpoints, choosing event topics, payloads, or delivery. Missing for 10: documented webhook creation/subscription to specific events, payload and signature/verification details, delivery/retry semantics, plan availability, hands-on or independent corroboration.
